scenarios.title: Severe hypoglycemia: rescue is not the end

evidence: Scenario severe-hypoglycemia-recurrence carries stable content version 0.1.3.
Capability version 0.1.0-alpha.48 is bound by this audit.
The declarative scenario schema validates a bounded fictional patient profile.
5 objectives map to debrief rubric evidence.

Fixed authored initial state; no randomized hypoglycemia transitions. Reference seed 4901. tests/unit/endocrine-hypoglycemia-guidance.test.ts replays expert, error, and recovery across guidance levels.

src/modules/endocrine-metabolic/severe-hypoglycemia.ts advances deterioration, post-rescue response, recurrence, and repeat response from the shared simulation clock. tests/unit/endocrine-severe-hypoglycemia.test.ts verifies exact boundaries and stale measurements.

Eight declared actions include glucose observation, support, rescue, medication review, monitoring, premature closure, and handoff. Oral rescue is refused; delayed rescue and early closure lead to distinct error and recovery transcripts.
The scenario executes through the shared deterministic anesthesia engine rather than a display-only script.

The model ends at qualified monitored handoff or instructor takeover after untreated hypoglycemia. Ended branches refuse later actions without inventing death, neurologic outcome, or discharge safety.

Eight observed-state tutor rules at version 0.1.0 provide Guided, Coached, and Unassisted behavior. Worked example 0.1.1 follows accepted actions and observed responses through the real engine; tests/unit/endocrine-hypoglycemia-demonstration.test.ts, tests/ui/endocrine-hypoglycemia-demonstration.test.tsx, and tests/integration/demonstration-runs.test.tsx verify paused reading checkpoints, distinct repeated-rescue steps, single-dispatch Continue, takeover cancellation, and objective evidence.

src/modules/anesthesia/ui/Debrief.tsx maps five objectives to accepted engine events, preserves unsafe choices after correction, and labels the no-rescue comparison as an authored counterfactual. PEARLS reflection remains in the shared debrief.
2 source citation(s) are declared.
3 limitation record(s) are linked.

src/modules/endocrine-metabolic/severe-hypoglycemia-fixtures.ts binds expert, commonError, and recovery fixtures to content 0.1.3 and seed 4901. Real-engine replay tests verify distinct outcomes and guidance independence.

Automated UI, offline architecture, deterministic replay, and desktop browser checks exist. Per-scenario moderated screen-reader, reduced-motion, color-vision, 320 px, and performance evidence remains incomplete.

The shared reporting control and exact-version report records exist; the centered modal, length limit, and keyboard dismissal were checked on the briefing. Complete per-scenario evidence across briefing, live, debrief, and provenance is still pending.

scenarios.title: Thyroid storm: treat the person, not just the pulse

evidence: Scenario thyroid-storm-hemodynamic-risk carries stable content version 0.1.0.
Capability version 0.1.0-alpha.48 is bound by this audit.
The declarative scenario schema validates a bounded fictional patient profile.
5 objectives map to debrief rubric evidence.

Fixed authored thyroid transitions and reference seed 4903; tests/integration/thyroid-storm-runs.test.ts verifies real-engine replay hashes, including presentation, actions, observations, and event evidence.

thyroid-storm.ts advances incomplete-care deterioration, a later partial-support state, and bounded instructor takeover independently of observation. The one-hour iodine sequence is distinct from authored response clocks.

Ten dose-free decisions include parallel urgent care, circulation assessment, individualized rate review, sequenced iodine, fresh reassessment, handoff, and retained diagnostic-delay and blanket-beta-blockade mistakes.
The scenario executes through the shared deterministic anesthesia engine rather than a display-only script.
Ongoing-care handoff or instructor takeover ends the model; 30-minute incomplete urgent care and four-hour unfinished-lesson stops are authored, not safe treatment delays or predicted outcomes.
Exact-version observed-state inline tutoring supports Guided, Coached, and Unassisted. A learner-paced worked example is not yet implemented.

3 source citation(s) are declared.
